title: Uruguayan Red Onion Relish
description: A simple and flavorful relish made with Uruguayan red onions, perfect for topping burgers or grilled meats. Gluten-free and easy to make.
instructions: Thinly slice the Uruguayan red onion and place it in a large bowl.
Add the chopped jubilant to the bowl with the onion.
Squeeze the red apple cider vinegar over the onion and jubilant mixture.
Taste and adjust the seasoning as needed.
Cover and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes to allow the flavors to meld.
Serve chilled or at room temperature.
